parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.fr_documents (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

ALTER TABLE public.fr_documents
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS document_number TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS title TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS abstract TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS document_type TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS publication_date DATE,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS agency TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS agency_slugs TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS html_url TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS pdf_url TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS comment_url TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS matched_terms TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS matched_agencies TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS matched_policy_terms TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS strict_score NUMERIC,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS embedding_score NUMERIC,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ai_decision TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ai_relevance_status TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS type_of_action TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS urgency TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS advocacy_relevance TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS deadline_sensitivity TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS ai_summary TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS why_it_matters TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS actionability TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS recommended_action TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS talking_points TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS deadline TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS verification_instructions TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS disclaimer TEXT,
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS lookup_mode TEXT;

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fr_documents_publication_date
  ON public.fr_documents (publication_date);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fr_documents_ai_decision
  ON public.fr_documents (ai_decision);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_fr_documents_agency
  ON public.fr_documents (agency);

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO public.fr_documents (
  id,
  document_number,
  title,
  abstract,
  document_type,
  publication_date,
  agency,
  agency_slugs,
  html_url,
  pdf_url,
  comment_url,
  matched_terms,
  matched_agencies,
  matched_policy_terms,
  strict_score,
  embedding_score,
  ai_decision,
  ai_relevance_status,
  type_of_action,
  urgency,
  advocacy_relevance,
  deadline_sensitivity,
  ai_summary,
  why_it_matters,
  actionability,
  recommended_action,
  talking_points,
  deadline,
  verification_instructions,
  disclaimer,
  lookup_mode,
  created_at,
  updated_at
)
VALUES (
  '{{ ($json.id || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.document_number || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.title || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.abstract || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.document_type || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  NULLIF('{{ $json.publication_date || "" }}', '')::date,
  '{{ ($json.agency || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.agency_slugs || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.html_url || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.pdf_url || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.comment_url || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ (Array.isArray($json.matched_terms) ? $json.matched_terms.join(", ") : ($json.matched_terms || "")).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ (Array.isArray($json.matched_agencies) ? $json.matched_agencies.join(", ") : ($json.matched_agencies || "")).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ (Array.isArray($json.matched_policy_terms) ? $json.matched_policy_terms.join(", ") : ($json.matched_policy_terms || "")).replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ Number($json.strict_score || 0) }},
  {{ Number($json.embedding_score || 0) }},
  '{{ ($json.ai_decision || "SEND").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.ai_relevance_status || "RELEVANT").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.type_of_action || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.urgency || "Low").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.advocacy_relevance || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.deadline_sensitivity || "None").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.ai_summary || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.why_it_matters || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.actionability || "Monitoring Only").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.recommended_action || "Research further").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.talking_points || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.deadline || "None").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.verification_instructions || "Open the official Federal Register source link, confirm the agency, publication date, document number, comment deadline, and action type before taking any advocacy action.").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.disclaimer || "This represents informational guidance only and not legal advice.").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.lookup_mode || "historical_animal_backfill_strict_final_only").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  document_number = EXCLUDED.document_number,
  title = EXCLUDED.title,
  abstract = EXCLUDED.abstract,
  document_type = EXCLUDED.document_type,
  publication_date = EXCLUDED.publication_date,
  agency = EXCLUDED.agency,
  agency_slugs = EXCLUDED.agency_slugs,
  html_url = EXCLUDED.html_url,
  pdf_url = EXCLUDED.pdf_url,
  comment_url = EXCLUDED.comment_url,
  matched_terms = EXCLUDED.matched_terms,
  matched_agencies = EXCLUDED.matched_agencies,
  matched_policy_terms = EXCLUDED.matched_policy_terms,
  strict_score = EXCLUDED.strict_score,
  embedding_score = EXCLUDED.embedding_score,
  ai_decision = EXCLUDED.ai_decision,
  ai_relevance_status = EXCLUDED.ai_relevance_status,
  type_of_action = EXCLUDED.type_of_action,
  urgency = EXCLUDED.urgency,
  advocacy_relevance = EXCLUDED.advocacy_relevance,
  deadline_sensitivity = EXCLUDED.deadline_sensitivity,
  ai_summary = EXCLUDED.ai_summary,
  why_it_matters = EXCLUDED.why_it_matters,
  actionability = EXCLUDED.actionability,
  recommended_action = EXCLUDED.recommended_action,
  talking_points = EXCLUDED.talking_points,
  deadline = EXCLUDED.deadline,
  verification_instructions = EXCLUDED.verification_instructions,
  disclaimer = EXCLUDED.disclaimer,
  lookup_mode = EXCLUDED.lookup_mode,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, title, agency, publication_date, ai_decision, embedding_score;
